entry.title: Updated: dsh-coyote
entry.summary: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only. Exact install spec: dsh-coyote. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
